adaptive_rules.coach_note: Modern CAN-bus lighting may need coding after LED swaps — random bulbs can throw errors.
Sensor codes need confirmation — don't replace ABS/wheel-speed sensors on a code alone without checking harness/tone rings.
Hybrids/EVs: stay on 12V lighting/sensors. Orange HV remains off-limits.

risk_confirm.body: Probing or unplugging SRS connectors can deploy airbags or disable crash protection. Do not DIY airbag work. Find a nearby shop.

steps.title: Check the right fuse
steps.coach_encourage: Exact amperage only — never upsize a fuse. You're crushing it — roughly 43% done.
steps.personalize: Fuse check for your {{model}} at {{mileage}} miles. Recheck circuits by ~{{next_service}} miles if it blows again.
steps.description: Use the diagram for the failed circuit. A blown fuse means fix the short, not a bigger fuse. Repeating blows → shop.
steps.safety_disclaimer: General guidance only. Follow your owner's manual or an authorized tech. This app isn't liable for DIY damage.

risk_confirm.title: Electrical short / fire risk
risk_confirm.body: Installing a higher-amp fuse than specified can cause wiring fires. Replace only with the same amperage. If fuses keep blowing, find a nearby shop.
risk_confirm.checkbox_label: I have read and understand the risks
risk_confirm.disclaimer: This is general guidance only. Always follow your owner's manual or an authorized technician. This app is not responsible for damage from DIY work.
